classification: UK PUBLIC SOURCE EXPANSION — DISCOVERY / INGESTION PREPARATION / PRODUCTION APPLY NOT AUTHORIZED

production_read_only_checkpoint.query_scope: read-only count and source-name aggregate; no user profile or account data selected

selected_source_assessments.finding: National Rail identifies Knowledgebase as the station-facilities content engine, available as XML via self-sign-up and REST API. The specific facility feed and permitted reuse terms must be obtained through the registered portal before retrieval or republishing.
selected_source_assessments.candidate_action: Do not scrape National Rail pages or use an unofficial mirror; request the registered station facilities feed and retain its source identity and terms.

selected_source_assessments.licence_or_terms: TfL Open Data terms / live-feed registration required
selected_source_assessments.finding: TfL says the public example is not updated and the live feed requires registration. The example has station names, a public-toilet flag, and notes, but no coordinates, so it cannot independently create Relief facilities.
selected_source_assessments.candidate_action: Obtain the registered current feed and join only through an authoritative station identity/coordinate source; preserve nulls and treat toilet flags as source facts, not canonical certainty.

selected_source_assessments.finding: The National Data Library entry identifies a Rother public-toilet dataset, current metadata, and OGL. The listed public-toilet information resource is not enough by itself to establish a current coordinate-bearing machine feed, stable row identity, or operational status.
selected_source_assessments.candidate_action: Contact or verify the council resource before ingesting; do not treat a stale PDF, closed site, or metadata-only entry as current canonical evidence.

selected_source_assessments.finding: DataMapWales publishes a National Toilet Map supplied by local authorities, but the layer metadata names PSGA. The portal-wide statement that OGL is used where possible does not override the layer-specific licence metadata.
selected_source_assessments.candidate_action: Obtain written confirmation that Relief may reuse and republish the layer and any derived coordinates; otherwise retain as research-only.

selected_source_assessments.licence_or_terms: Publisher-specific; OGL only where expressly stated
selected_source_assessments.finding: The Scottish data platform is transitioning from statistics.gov.scot. Catalogue-level OGL availability is not evidence of a current facility-level public-toilet dataset.
selected_source_assessments.candidate_action: Revisit after the platform transition and select only a named, current, coordinate-bearing source with explicit licence and stable identity.

selected_source_assessments.finding: No current facility-level official toilet feed with clearly verified reuse terms was selected in this bounded review.
selected_source_assessments.candidate_action: Do not ingest directory pages, community registries, or unverified mirrors; continue only after a named publisher and explicit licence are confirmed.

implementation.raw_snapshot_policy: ignored local content-addressed cache; never force-added
implementation.normalization_policy: unknown values remain null; OSGB36 easting/northing is not treated as WGS84 latitude/longitude
implementation.matching_policy: source identity only for exact matches; name-only matches remain unresolved
